ai.command_policy_tip: This policy controls commands and other host operations initiated by AI. Fewer confirmations improve speed but increase the risk of unintended changes.
ai.command_policy_auto_description: Every AI operation runs immediately without manual confirmation or independent AI review.
ai.command_policy_auto_detail: Fastest and highest risk. Use only in isolated, disposable test environments; not recommended for production hosts.
ai.command_policy_auto_review_description: A separate AI reviews normal operations first; high-risk, unclear, failed, or timed-out reviews require your confirmation.
ai.command_policy_auto_review_detail: Balances automation and safety, but each review adds a model call and latency. Best for controlled environments that need fewer manual prompts.
ai.command_policy_balanced_description: Low-risk read operations run automatically; changes such as writing files, installing software, or modifying services require confirmation.
ai.command_policy_balanced_detail: Recommended for routine host administration. It preserves workflow speed while intercepting operations that may change system state.
ai.command_policy_always_description: Every command or host operation initiated by AI requires your confirmation before it runs.
ai.command_policy_always_detail: Provides the most human control and the most interruptions. Use for production, sensitive hosts, or your first AI-assisted session.
ai.command_timeout_tip: Maximum runtime for one command. When it expires, execution is stopped and the result is returned to AI.
ai.approval_review_settings_tip: Review uses a separate AI request and consumes additional model quota. Cases that cannot be judged reliably still require manual confirmation.
ai.approval_review_profile_tip: Optionally use a separate API environment for review. Leave empty to follow the environment used by the conversation.
ai.approval_review_model_tip: You can choose a faster, lower-cost review model. Leave empty to use the review environment or conversation model.
ai.approval_review_timeout_tip: Maximum wait for a review request. A timeout never auto-approves the operation; it falls back to manual confirmation.
ai.include_command_snippets_tip: When enabled, AI can read summaries of command snippets visible to the current user, and request specific content only when needed.

credential_rotation.title: Credential rotation
credential_rotation.description: Centrally update SSH asset passwords and private keys to reduce the maintenance burden of long-lived credentials.
credential_rotation.benefit_1: Rotate credentials in batches or through scheduled policies.
credential_rotation.benefit_2: Handle assets sharing a credential together to reduce per-host changes.
credential_rotation.benefit_3: Review rotation results and failure reasons for follow-up.

restricted_features.label: Premium feature
restricted_features.license_note: Your current license does not include this feature.

access_policy.title: Identity access policies
access_policy.description: Define access boundaries by person, source and time for teams with departmental or remote access requirements.
access_policy.benefit_1: Combine IP address sets, location and time conditions.
access_policy.benefit_2: Assign policies to users or departments to reduce repeated setup.
access_policy.benefit_3: Evaluate allow and reject rules by priority for consistent access decisions.

agent_gateway.title: Agent gateways
agent_gateway.description: Deploy an Agent in the target network to provide a shared entry point for asset connections.
agent_gateway.benefit_1: Use Agent connection channels for assets in private networks.
agent_gateway.benefit_2: View gateway online status and versions for routine maintenance.
agent_gateway.benefit_3: Reuse a gateway across assets to simplify cross-network setup.

gateway_group.title: Gateway groups
gateway_group.description: Organize multiple gateways into reusable groups for environments with several connection entry points.
gateway_group.benefit_1: Maintain group members centrally to reduce repeated asset configuration.
gateway_group.benefit_2: Choose gateways by priority, latency or randomly to suit connection needs.
gateway_group.benefit_3: Reuse groups across assets to make future gateway changes easier.

authorization_strategy.title: Authorization strategies
authorization_strategy.description: Control file operations and clipboard capabilities according to each team’s responsibilities.
authorization_strategy.benefit_1: Manage file upload and download permissions separately.
authorization_strategy.benefit_2: Set permissions for creating, editing, deleting and renaming files.
authorization_strategy.benefit_3: Control copy and paste capabilities according to operational needs.

command_filter.title: Command filters
command_filter.description: Define terminal command rules for operations that need restrictions on high-risk commands.
command_filter.benefit_2: Apply command rules through resource authorization.
command_filter.benefit_3: Reduce the chance of accidentally executing high-risk commands.

oidc.title: OIDC single sign-on
oidc.description: Connect an existing OIDC identity provider so your team can sign in with a shared corporate identity.
oidc.benefit_1: Reuse the corporate sign-in entry point to reduce account maintenance.
oidc.benefit_2: Integrate identity providers through standard OIDC.
oidc.benefit_3: Configure department assignment for users who sign in.

ldap.title: LDAP directory authentication
ldap.description: Authenticate users with information from your existing enterprise LDAP directory.
ldap.benefit_1: Reuse directory accounts to reduce duplicate user maintenance.
ldap.benefit_2: Limit eligible users with search scopes and filters.
ldap.benefit_3: Map user attributes to match your directory structure.

wechat_work.title: WeCom sign-in
wechat_work.description: Let teams sign in through WeCom using their existing corporate identity.
wechat_work.benefit_1: Simplify sign-in with a familiar identity provider.
wechat_work.benefit_2: Configure corporate and application details centrally.
wechat_work.benefit_3: Assign users to departments for platform permission management.

branding.title: Custom branding
branding.description: Give your operations portal a recognizable identity with your organization’s name and logo.
branding.benefit_1: Use a custom system name and logo.
branding.benefit_3: Keep branding consistent across sign-in and administration screens.

session_sharing.title: Session sharing
session_sharing.description: Share the current session’s access link to help collaborators see the same context.
session_sharing.benefit_1: Share the current session instead of describing every step.
session_sharing.benefit_2: Use a link to join a shared session for troubleshooting.
session_sharing.benefit_3: Cancel sharing when the task is complete.

website_geo.title: Website location rules
website_geo.description: Limit public access by country, province or city to define where a website can be reached from.
website_geo.benefit_1: Configure country, province and city conditions.
website_geo.benefit_2: Combine location conditions with existing IP rules.

response_rewrite.title: Website response modification
response_rewrite.description: Configure response rules at the proxy layer for websites that need adapted return content.
response_rewrite.benefit_1: Maintain response modification rules in one place.
response_rewrite.benefit_2: Process responses at the proxy to reduce source application changes.
response_rewrite.benefit_3: Apply separate rules for each website.

geodata.title: IP geolocation data
geodata.description: Maintain the IP location data used by regional access rules and source analysis.
geodata.benefit_1: View the state of the geolocation dataset.
geodata.benefit_2: Upload and update data to maintain its version.
geodata.benefit_3: Schedule automatic updates to reduce manual work.

recording_conversion.title: Recording conversion policies
recording_conversion.description: Schedule session recording conversion to balance availability with server processing load.
recording_conversion.benefit_1: Convert recordings immediately or during idle hours.
recording_conversion.benefit_2: Set a time window for conversion work.
recording_conversion.benefit_3: Choose whether to retain original recordings.

access_request.title: Access requests
access_request.description: Route temporary asset access needs through an application and approval process.
access_request.benefit_1: Provide users with a single asset access request entry point.
access_request.benefit_2: Handle access needs through approval instead of offline coordination.
access_request.benefit_3: Connect requests with resource access management for easier tracking.

sql_work_order.title: SQL Work Order Approval
sql_work_order.description: Review and approve database changes before the platform executes SQL.
sql_work_order.benefit_1: Review SQL and the target database before execution.
sql_work_order.benefit_2: Execute approved changes through the platform to reduce manual handoffs.
sql_work_order.benefit_3: Keep requester, approver and execution results together for traceability.

agent_access.title: Agent access
agent_access.description: Install the Next Terminal Skill for OpenClaw, Hermes or custom agents. Install once, then query and manage resources with the installed client.
agent_access.key_instruction: Configure NT_API_KEY securely in the agent environment; do not paste the key into a conversation.
agent_access.setup_tip: Create an api token on the account access tokens page and configure NT_API_KEY locally. Save the Skill as next-terminal/SKILL.md and the client as next-terminal/scripts/nt_api.py. Enter next-terminal and run the commands below. Only Python 3 is required. Use --token-env for a different environment variable name.
agent_access.prompt:
Install the Next Terminal resource management Skill for {{url}}.

1. Identify this agent framework’s persistent Skill directory and use its next-terminal-api subdirectory. Do not use temporary storage or only read the Skill for this conversation.
2. Download {{url}}/agent/next-terminal/install.py and run python3 install.py --base-url {{url}} --directory <persistent-skill-directory>/next-terminal-api. It installs SKILL.md and scripts/nt_api.py and saves instance configuration without secrets. If an existing installation targets another instance, confirm the directory before overwriting it.
3. Load or reload the installed Skill according to the framework. I configured NT_API_KEY in the persistent agent environment. Do not print, save or request the key in chat. If missing, tell me where to configure it.
4. Run the installed scripts/nt_api.py check. Report the installation directory, Skill loading status and account name; report failures accurately.
5. Use the installed Skill and client for subsequent authorized resource management tasks.

After installation and verification, wait for my task.

Also run scripts/nt_api.py permissions to obtain account permissions and the effective license. Check them before selecting interfaces; visibility in the complete document does not authorize calls.
agent_access.permissions: The agent inherits the API key account’s permissions. Set an expiry and revoke the token when retiring the agent.
agent_access.heading: Connect your agent to manage resources
agent_access.step_key_tip: Open access tokens, select the API token type and set an expiry. Copy the new token. If you already have a valid API key, continue to the next step.
agent_access.step_configure_tip: Add NT_API_KEY to the agent secrets, environment or startup configuration. Set its value to your token and reload or restart the agent as required.
agent_access.config_hint: Use NT_API_KEY in configuration that persists across sessions, rather than a temporary terminal. Do not send the key in a conversation.
agent_access.step_agent: Install the Skill and API client
agent_access.step_agent_tip: Send these installation instructions to your agent. It will install the complete Skill and client in its persistent Skill directory, save the instance configuration and verify connectivity.
agent_access.copied: Installation instructions copied. Send them to your agent.
agent_access.copy_failed: Copy failed. Expand the installation instructions and copy them manually.
agent_access.verify_tip: The agent will report the installation directory and connection result. Assign future resource management tasks without repeating setup.
agent_access.advanced_tip: The installed Skill includes interface discovery and API requests. Use these references for custom integrations.
